item.title: BTS Revives Group’s Historic Visit to Mexico’s National Palace in New Video
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest news and trends in the music world. Today, we're talking about K-pop supergroup BTS and their historic visit to Mexico's National Palace. Let's take a look."
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: "On May 27, BTS released a new video on their official channels, giving fans a behind-the-scenes look at their visit to the presidential residence. The video shows the group exploring the gardens, meeting with President Claudia Sheinbaum, and even waving to their fans, known as ARMY, from the balcony overlooking the Zócalo, the country's main public square."
[Clip of RM saying "¡Hola, somos BTS!" plays]
Host: "One of the most memorable moments from the visit was when RM greeted the crowd in Spanish, saying 'Hello, we are BTS!' The crowd of 50,000 people went wild, and you can even hear a mariachi band playing in the background, courtesy of some dedicated fans."
[Clip of V saying "México, mucho picante" plays]
Host: "The video also shows the group's lighthearted side, with RM asking V to say a phrase that's become a fan favorite: 'Mexico, very spicy.' And who can blame them? The crowd's energy was electric."
[Soft music continues to play]
Host: "The group's visit to Mexico was such a success that President Sheinbaum announced that BTS will be returning to the country next year. Although there's no official confirmation from the group or their representatives, it's clear that they made a lasting impression on their Mexican fans."
[Outro music starts to play]
Host: "That's all for today's episode. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next one. Don't forget to follow us for more music news and updates."
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
